s00F120.name: Block interaction: hurt tiles, bounce blocks, coins
summary: Tail of the Mario-versus-tile code. Several entry points share it, all working on the touched tile number (Y or A) and the hit side (Y):
$00F120: spikes/munchers. Tile $2F always hurts; castle spike tiles hurt in castle tilesets ($1931 = 1) and some ghost house ones; skipped on Yoshi.
$00F160: tiles $11-$2D and $6A/$6B that can be hit from below. Looks up bounce sprite, contents and replacement block, then spawns the bounce sprite.
Switch palace blocks keep hit flags in $13F3. $00F267: grab a turn block. $00F28C: invisible 1-up checkpoint tiles ($6F-$72, must be touched in order).
$00F2C0: other tile classes (climbing flags, $38 pickup, 3-up moon $6E, coins, Yoshi coins). $00F377/$00F38A: spawn a score sprite at Mario.
$00F3B2: bit array helper for the level number. $00F3C4: pipe entry check for tile $3F.
Parameters: Y = tile number / side as described per entry. Several parts are only hedged guesses (see line comments).

PIPE_BUTTONS.name: Pipe entry, map16 lookup at collision point
summary: PIPE_BUTTONS: controller bit needed to enter a pipe, indexed 0-3 (Left, Right, Up, Down).
$00F3E9: entry for tiles $37/$38 (A = button index). Checks alignment, the button in [$15], then starts the pipe animation ([$71], [$1419], [$88], [$89]).
$00F443: carry = Mario's center is in the right half of a block. $00F44D: sets the collision point [$9A]/[$98] from Mario's position plus table offset.
$00F465: converts the collision point to a map16 address for layer 1 or 2, horizontal or vertical level ([$8E]), reads the tile low byte into [$1693]
and the high byte into A, then adjusts for switches via $00F545. Out of range: Y = $25 (empty), A = 0.
Returns: Y = [$1693], A = high byte, Z set from A.
$00F545: P-switch tile swapping, first part (tile $29 invisible POW block becomes $24 while the blue POW is active).

PSwitchNotInvQBlk.name: P-switch: coin and switch palace tiles
summary: Tile $2B (coin) goes to PSwitchCoinBrown; tiles $EC-$FB set [$1423] and become a brown block ($32); others return with A = 0.

PSwitchCoinBrown.name: P-switch tile swaps and fall-off kill
summary: PSwitchCoinBrown: coin becomes a brown block ($32) while the blue POW is active.
$00F577: high byte non-zero: brown block becomes a coin while blue POW is active; muncher becomes a coin while the silver POW is active.
$00F595: called each frame: stops Mario rising more than $80 pixels above the screen, kills him (or finishes the level via $00C95B in special
levels, [$1B95]) when he is more than a screen below.

HurtMario.name: Hurt Mario
summary: Ignored during an animation, flashing, star power or level end. Small Mario dies, cape Mario soaring loses the soaring, others power down.

CancelSoaring.name: Hurt: cape soaring ends
summary: Plays a sound, sets the spin jump flag and a flashing timer of $30 and clears the cape status.

PowerDown.name: Hurt: shrink to small Mario
summary: Plays sound $04, drops the reserve item, starts animation 1, sets Mario to small and sets the hurt timer to $2F.

KillMario.name: Kill Mario
summary: Mario Y speed = $90, death music, animation 9, hurt/lock timer $30, clears cape status. $00F60A is the entry without the upward speed.

NoButtons.name: Clear controller, Mario GFX DMA setup
summary: NoButtons: clears the controller mirrors [$15]-[$18]. $00F629 kills Mario first.
$00F636: builds Mario's graphics DMA list ($0D85-$0D99) from the tile words [$09]-[$0C] and sets [$0D84] = $0A. Called from CODE_00E458.
